title: Reference plan collection index
description: Structured metadata for the V1 curated set of residential reference plans (docs/architecture_reference/references/README.md documents the rights policy and how to add an entry).

$schema.description: Relative link back to this schema file, for editors/tools that resolve it automatically.

generated.description: Date this index file was last curated (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

id.description: Unique, kebab-case identifier. Also the directory name under references/<id>/ for any copied files.

title.description: Short human-readable label for the plan.

dwelling_type.description: V1 scope is private houses only (docs/wiki/decisions/private-house-v1-scope.md). Extend this enum in a follow-up before adding other dwelling types.

footprint_family.description: The five footprint families this V1 set must cover (Issue #30).

levels.description: single = one storey, multi = two or more storeys.

level_count.description: Optional: exact storey count when known (omit if unknown).

bathrooms.description: Count of bathrooms; .5 denotes a half-bath/guest WC in addition to full bathrooms.

rights.description: owner = owner-provided material we may copy; public-domain / open-license = copyable under the stated license; metadata-only = describe + link, never copy (see README rights policy).

source_url.description: Link to the original source, or null if none is retained/applicable.

license.description: License identifier or statement covering the source material; null when rights is metadata-only and no license was ever recorded.

source.description: Free-text attribution: who/what this entry's metadata was derived from.

notes.description: Architectural notes: why this entry was curated, what it illustrates, any caveats.

files.description: Relative paths under references/<id>/ for copied files. MUST be empty when rights is metadata-only (see README and AC-3).

annotation.description: True when references/<id>/annotation.md exists with the 'why this plan works' / trade-offs / anti-patterns-avoided sections (Issue #31). Every entry must carry this.

concept.description: Optional structured concept-pattern block (Issue #77): the same descriptive vocabulary app.vertical_slice.concept_spec.py and app.vertical_slice.concept_patterns.py use, filled from this entry's own tags/annotation. Never geometry — see references/README.md's rights note.

circulation_class.description: app.vertical_slice.concept_spec.CirculationClass — the parti this entry's private-wing/circulation organisation belongs to.

zoning_split.description: app.vertical_slice.concept_spec.ZoningSplit — where the public zone sits relative to circulation/private.

wet_core_grouping.description: app.vertical_slice.concept_spec.WetCoreGrouping — the coarse wet-room-to-bedroom grouping (same vocabulary as ConceptSpec.wet_core_strategy).

master_placement.description: app.vertical_slice.concept_spec.MasterPlacement — where the primary/master bedroom sits relative to this entry's circulation.

entrance_side.description: app.vertical_slice.concept_spec.EntranceSide — where the entrance sits relative to this entry's massing.
